name: mod-void-wanderers
title: Void Wanderers unchanged: its campaign activity hosted, joined and played over the lockstep transport

checklist.what: the mod is present before this scenario is run
checklist.assert: driver refuses the run when <repo>/Data/VoidWanderers.rte is absent
checklist.blocked_by: VoidWanderers.rte is NOT installed on this machine. <repo>/Data holds only Base.rte, Browncoats.rte, Coalition.rte, Dummy.rte, Imperatus.rte, Missions.rte, MuIlaak.rte, Ronin.rte, Techion.rte, Tests.rte, Uzira.rte and the Modding folder; there is no Mods folder in the tree (the runner makes an empty one per run). The lead installs the mod into <repo>/Data before this scenario can run, and confirms its activity and preset names against its Index.ini - the two names below are written from the mod's documented ones and must be checked against the installed copy.

checklist.what: the engine loads with VoidWanderers.rte and reaches the main menu with no console error and no missing-preset warning
checklist.assert: menu script: assert_screen MainScreen, assert_console 0 (the error console never opened itself) plus a log scan for ERROR lines

checklist.what: the mod's own activity plays: its Lua runs, its actors and objects behave as they did before this fork's changes
checklist.assert: input script drives the seat; no Lua traceback in the log

checklist.what: the same mod activity runs over the lockstep transport on two peers and the two videos agree
checklist.assert: both match reports and a frame-by-frame compare of the two contact sheets

checklist.what: no Lua or native API behaviour the mod relies on has changed
checklist.assert: logs carry no [lua] error, no RTE Assert and no missing-property warning on either run
